secrets.name: BANKONE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer token for the Bankone Source Connector v1 origin (https://bankone.cars.tk, the lucronn/bankone project). Without it catalog hydration is rejected upstream (401) and the vehicle picker stays empty. Optional at boot: the stack starts without it.
